title: Holey Artisan Attack
subtitle: The 1 July 2016 attack and siege at a restaurant in Gulshan, Dhaka
summary: On the evening of 1 July 2016, armed attackers entered the Holey Artisan Bakery restaurant in Dhaka’s Gulshan area and held people inside during an overnight siege. Bangladeshi authorities treated the incident as a terrorist attack; a later court process attributed the conspiracy to the Neo-JMB network. The Islamic State group also claimed responsibility, while the government identified a domestic militant group. This chapter omits casualty totals because the sources currently attached to it do not establish a consistent figure.
heroTagline: The Holey Artisan attack and overnight siege, 1–2 July 2016
whyItMatters: The attack brought militant violence into a prominent international and diplomatic district and prompted an intensified security response. Responsibility claims require attribution: the Islamic State claim and the Bangladeshi government’s account differed, while court findings later identified Neo-JMB involvement. The account should distinguish those claims from judicial findings.
